==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. (My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like ""Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes."") This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) I went on a solo mission in the Storyverse. I fully embraced the power of dream doors. Dream doors are random doorways that lead from one dream to the next. They can be a little disorienting and can even make you lose lucidity. I was stuck in a realistic dream for a little while, but I was able to regain lucidity and leave through a dream door. Dream doors can be literally anything. I encountered a living wooden alligator, ripped it open, and crawled through it into another dream. That's how wild they can be. I even encountered menacing alien entities who seemed to be aware of the doors. I had to avoid them as I maneuvered from dream to dream. This dream was extremely adventurous, as I had very little sense of direction. I knew I could use the doors to go anywhere, but I didn't control the doors. I just let them take me wherever they led. This lucid dream fulfilled my desire to explore the unknown. It is strange to think that the grey aliens I encountered in a previous dream were so curious and welcoming, while the stranger purple armored aliens of tonight's dream were definitely up to no good.
